message: 共に生きることを選ぶ者達へ

name: Eauderourke
message: 「One extra-large, coming right up!」
A lively voice rings out from inside the beef bowl shop.

name: Sally
message: 「Well? He's working hard, isn't he~」

name: Synn
message: 「I barely recognized him. To think that Eauderourke could project such an energetic voice.」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, duh. It's basically like dangling a carrot in front of a horse's face, after all.」
What a terrible way to talk about her own boss.

name: Sally
message: 「Though it looks like he sneaks a bite every now and then and gets yelled at for it.」

name: Synn
message: 「He could just say he's tasting it for quality, though.」

name: Sally
message: 「You're surprisingly scheming, Prez.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh my... if it isn't the Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Melphas-san.」

name: Sally
message: 「There's a pretentious-looking guy here!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Sally-chan! You shouldn't point at people!」

name: Melphas
message: 「I am deeply honored to receive such high praise.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? You aren't hitting on girls today?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Whenever fate grants me an encounter, I shall gladly call out to them at any time or place.」

name: Sally
message: 「If you're gonna hit on someone, how about me? Mm-hmm~\s04」

name: Melphas
message: 「That would be a crime... so I must decline.\s02」

name: Sally
message: 「Aaaah!! You're totally making fun of me!!」

name: Melphas
message: 「My sincerest apologies. Truth be told... I am somewhat weak when it comes to young demon ladies...」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh, you actually figured out I'm a demon.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... wait, a demon!?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Indeed. And her name is none other than Lady Sally.」

name: Sally
message: 「How do you know that!?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Because I take an interest in all things concerning women, without exception」

name: Sally
message: 「Are you a stalker, Melphas?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Yes. Just a bit of tailing」

name: Synn
message: 「That's straight-up a crime, though...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Hahaha, merely a witty little joke」

name: Melphas
message: 「Lady Sally is someone who acts alongside Eauderourke, one of the Seven Demon Generals, after all. I hear rumors about you quite often」

name: Synn
message: 「You're quite the celebrity, huh」

name: Sally
message: 「Ehehe~~, you're making me blush~~\s07」

name: Melphas
message: 「Still, to think someone once feared as one of the Seven Demon Generals would blend into the Human World and work a part-time job...」

name: Sally
message: 「There's tons of delicious food to eat in the Human World, you know」

name: Melphas
message: 「Indeed. Paying no mind to titles like Demon General and enjoying yourself to the fullest in accordance with the rules of the Human World is for the best」

name: Synn
message: 「You spend all your time hitting on girls too, Melphas-san」

name: Melphas
message: 「For that is the karma entrusted to me from the abyss, which I bear upon my shoulders」

name: Synn
message: 「I know it's a bit late to ask, but are you a demon, Melphas-san?」

name: Melphas
message: 「That is indeed the case」

name: Synn
message: 「And one of the Seven Demon Generals on top of that」

name: Melphas
message: 「It seems there are those who occasionally refer to me as such, yes」

name: Sally
message: 「I see~~. So that's how it is~~」

name: Sally
message: 「Eeeeh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「The Student Council also serves as the Crusaders who exterminate demons. Does that mean I have to fight you, Melphas-san?」

name: Melphas
message: 「When I raise my fists. In other words, that would be when you harm, defile, or bring shame upon all the lovely women I adore」

name: Melphas
message: 「Though if you wish to fight demons indiscriminately, that would be a different story」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, I don't have the slightest intention of doing that」

name: Melphas
message: 「Yes. Otherwise, I could hardly be arranging jobs for demons, now could I」

name: Synn
message: 「You mentioned the rules of the Human World earlier, so are there other demons like you out there, Melphas-san?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Yes, of course. Why, someone close to you might actually be a demon as well, you know?」
Could this guy have seen right through my true identity...?!

name: Melphas
message: 「However, as far as demons who have grown accustomed to living here go, you can't tell by appearance. It wouldn't be strange no matter how many are hiding among you.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Besides, it seems it's not just demons--other races blend in here too...」

name: Synn
message: 「Melphas-san. Just who are you...」

name: Melphas
message: 「I'm nothing more than a humble wandering man who loves women dearly.」
He flashes me a sickeningly sweet smile.

name: Melphas
message: 「Today is quite strange, though. Even though you're a man, I find myself getting carried away talking with you.」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me you're into guys...」

name: Melphas
message: 「I wouldn't mind in the slightest if you thought of it that way, you know?」
Brrr.

name: Sally
message: 「You're super popular, Prez.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Stop it!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Hehehe. Well then, farewell.」
Even among demons, they visit the Human World with all sorts of motives.
As long as their purpose isn't simply to harm others, nobody ever notices their existence.
They don't use magic, nor do they wield Spirit Arts.
They abide by the laws and rules of this world, living blended into the crowd.
It wouldn't even be strange to call people like that human anymore.
